paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.39% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+0.70%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-1.82%). Brent crude changed +0.89% to 106.63. Gold changed -1.82% to 4,101.2998. Bitcoin changed -1.37% to 81,957.9688. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.238%, a relative move of +0.40%. Among the firms tracked, Lazard (-6.34%) and Bank of America (-5.35%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: BlackRock pulls in $205bn to take assets to record high (FT World). World’s largest asset manager has become an increasingly powerful force in private capital after acquisitions of HPS and Global Infrastructure Partners Deals and capital markets: General Atlantic plans IPO at up to $10bn valuation (FT World). Private capital group looks to fund ambitious expansion plan to keep pace with rivals Blackstone and Apollo Global Central banks and macro: US inflation jumps to 3.7% as Iran war drives up prices (FT World). Rebound in fuel costs has piled pressure on voters ahead of midterm elections Central banks and macro: US grocery prices poised to climb as soaring fuel costs drive inflation (FT World). Food manufacturers warn of impact on consumers ahead of midterm elections Geopolitics and trade: Gulf oil production rebounds ahead of increase in Iran war hostilities (FT Markets). Saudi Arabia says output in September hit highest level since start of conflict, though revival now at risk from renewed attacks on shipping this month
